calibration.qualification: Measured static curve; Module 4 settling audit remains applicable. Revalidate with the rod attached.

metadata.settling_criterion: Planning starting tolerances: consecutive complete cycles change in mean <=0.1 C, amplitude <=5%, phase <=0.1 rad; justify against measured noise and repeatability before declaring settled.
metadata.settings_status: Second-period pilot; gains retained as a starting point, not certified tuning.
metadata.rationale: The 200 s pilot has repeatable TEC/T1/T2 responses but T3 fails the provisional five-cycle amplitude/phase span limits. Test a longer period to increase downstream response without moving sensors or changing mean/amplitude.
metadata.duration_note: 3600 s allows 7.2 cycles in total; at least five complete settled cycles are needed. If transients last too long, the retained interval may still be insufficient.
